plan.purpose: Matched 64-versus-144 OGPO recordings on the six shared unseen object categories; all fixed-sample outcomes retained.
plan.sampling_rule: One fixed seeded episode (episode 0) per shared unseen-object task, matching the original 64-task recordings. All six outcomes are retained without outcome-based selection.
plan.checkpoint_metadata_source: Supplied Drive export folder name; the original144 inventory only records name, folder URL and file sizes.

split_verification_144.note: Record exactly the shared six val_out categories. Task163 is val_in at144; task208 is explicitly in144 training, so both are excluded.

download.verification: File sizes match Drive; SHA256 records downloaded bytes.

64.interpretation: Historical Drive download hashes plus independently observed remote OCDBT manifest hash. This export does not rehash all checkpoint weight shards; params/_METADATA is a tensor-layout hash, not a unique weights fingerprint.

download.verification: File sizes match Drive; SHA256 digests identify downloaded bytes.

144.interpretation: Historical Drive download hashes plus independently observed remote OCDBT manifest hash. This export does not rehash all checkpoint weight shards; params/_METADATA is a tensor-layout hash, not a unique weights fingerprint.

interpretation: One fixed matched example per shared unseen-object category; not a new aggregate performance estimate.
timing: Native simulation speed with every recorded frame retained; final frames held through 482 frames, including at least two seconds after the horizon.
success_marker: Green tint and border from the simulator terminal success frame; failures never marked.

aggregate.label: Success on unseen objects
aggregate.source_label: Aggregate results · rounded from the accompanying figure
aggregate.provenance: Means and error-bar endpoints recovered from the published vector figures, not raw evaluation data. The six videos are a separate illustrative fixed sample. Error-bar interval definition is not inferred.
